# sfcompute_limits (Data Source)

Reads limits from SF Compute (`GET /preview/v2/limits`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sfcompute_limits" "current" {}

output "limits" {
  value = { for l in data.sfcompute_limits.current.data : l.name => "${l.usage} / ${l.value}" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Which limit this is. The name determines the unit of `value` and `usage`.
- `scope` (Map of String) Where this limit applies. `{}` means it applies account-wide; `{"sku": "sku_..."}` means orders on that one SKU.
- `usage` (String) How much of `value` your account has used, as a decimal string in the unit `name` implies (node hours, seconds, dollars, or a count). Omitted when the limit doesn't track usage or usage hasn't been measured yet.
- `value` (String) The ceiling, as a decimal string in the unit `name` implies (node hours, seconds, dollars, or a count). `null` means unlimited.
